It's so annoying seeing non artists in the comments who think that all art specifically animation is about is the detail in the colour and renderjng. Yeah that's important but remember the whole point of animation is movement and bringing it to life. You can colour and render well on a normal drawing, you dont need animation for that. Good animation isnt rated on the colour, the shading, the detail in face and clothing, it's rated on how characters and objects move, the placement of things, how everything is paced, how movement is utilised to express emotion and character. And from this trailer i think they absolutely nailed it. Think about if calcifer in howls moving castle looked almost like real fire, lighting was extremely well drawn and he was extremely detailed colour and texture wise, but he moved like a regular old stove fire. He would not be memorable at all. That's the true beauty of studio ghibli's animation; not the backgrounds, not the character designs, not the stories. It's how everything moves. It's how you can see how they move and think, 'that's ghibli work right there' even if they have no shadow, mundane block colours, simple line work.
